title: TabMail adds confirm-before-action AI to Thunderbird and iPhone
friendlyTitle: TabMail helps with email but asks before it acts
summary: TabMail offers open-source Thunderbird and iPhone clients with inbox search, summaries, draft assistance, calendar actions and email triage. It says actions require confirmation, personalisation stays on-device and its servers do not retain email or calendar content.
friendlySummary: TabMail can search, summarize, draft and organize email in Thunderbird or on iPhone. It says you must confirm actions before the agent carries them out.
whyItMatters: Email is a useful test of supervised agents because the time-saving actions are clear and mistakes are costly. Confirmation gates and local preferences are sensible design choices, but users should still review provider and privacy terms before connecting an inbox.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may save time while keeping you in control. Check the privacy details and read every message before the tool sends or deletes anything.
